BOOK3_LESSON_TWELVE_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–4 · Do You Have Interview Experience?

text.traditional: 您好，我是林家豪。貴公司上星期通知我今天十點來面試。
text.simplified: 您好，我是林家豪。贵公司上星期通知我今天十点来面试。
text.pinyin: Nínhǎo, wǒ shì Lín Jiāháo. Guì gōngsī shàng xīngqí tōngzhī wǒ jīntiān shí diǎn lái miànshì.
text.english: Hello, I am Lin Jiahao. Last week your company told me to come for an interview at ten today.

text.traditional: 林先生，歡迎您來本公司參加面試。請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
text.simplified: 林先生，欢迎您来本公司参加面试。请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
text.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng, huānyíng nín lái běn gōngsī cānjiā miànshì. Qǐng zuò yíxià, wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ.
text.english: Mr. Lin, welcome to our company for the interview. Please take a seat, I will inform the manager right away.

text.traditional: （在會議室）
text.simplified: （在会议室）
text.pinyin: (Zài huìyìshì)
text.english: (In the meeting room)

text.traditional: 你好。我姓王，負責今天的面試。
text.simplified: 你好。我姓王，负责今天的面试。
text.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo. Wǒ xìng Wáng, fùzé jīntiān de miànshì.
text.english: Hello. My surname is Wang, and I am in charge of today's interview.

text.traditional: 您好，王經理，我是林家豪。這是我的工作經驗相關資料，請您參考。
text.simplified: 您好，王经理，我是林家豪。这是我的工作经验相关资料，请您参考。
text.pinyin: Nínhǎo, Wáng jīnglǐ, wǒ shì Lín Jiāháo. Zhè shì wǒ de gōngzuò jīngyàn xiāngguān zīliào, qǐng nín cānkǎo.
text.english: Hello, Manager Wang, I am Lin Jiahao. This is the information related to my work experience for your reference.

text.traditional: （經理看了一下家豪的資料）
text.simplified: （经理看了一下家豪的资料）
text.pinyin: (Jīnglǐ kàn le yíxià Jiāháo de zīliào)
text.english: (The manager looks over Jiahao's papers.)

text.traditional: 這次我們要找的是銷售人員，你在這方面有經驗嗎？
text.simplified: 这次我们要找的是销售人员，你在这方面有经验吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xiāoshòu rényuán, nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
text.english: We are looking for sales personnel this time. Do you have experience in this field?

text.traditional: 念大學時，我在電腦公司打過工。向客人介紹商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差異，最重要的是想辦法把商品賣出去。
text.simplified: 念大学时，我在电脑公司打过工。向客人介绍商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差异，最重要的是想办法把商品卖出去。
text.pinyin: Niàn dàxué shí, wǒ zài diànnǎo gōngsī dǎ guò gōng. Xiàng kèrén jièshào shāngpǐn gōngnéng, shǐyòng fāngfǎ, hé qítā páizi de chāyì, zuì zhòngyào de shì xiǎng bànfǎ bǎ shāngpǐn mài chū qù.
text.english: In university, I worked part-time at a computer company, introducing product features, instructions, and differences from other brands to customers. The most important thing was finding ways to sell products.

text.traditional: 不過推銷時，多多少少都會碰到喜歡隨便批評，甚至對你亂發脾氣的客人，你會怎麼處理呢？
text.simplified: 不过推销时，多多少少都会碰到喜欢随便批评，甚至对你乱发脾气的客人，你会怎么处理呢？
text.pinyin: Búguò tuīxiāo shí, duōduōshǎoshǎo dōu huì pèngdào xǐhuān suíbiàn pīpíng, shènzhì duì nǐ luàn fāpíqì de kèrén, nǐ huì zěnme chǔlǐ ne?
text.english: However, when selling, you will more or less encounter customers who criticize casually or even lose their tempers at you. How would you handle that?

text.traditional: 我會先了解問題是什麼，然後耐心地跟他說明，想辦法讓他理解。我想只要態度親切、謙虛，客人就會接受的。萬一他還是不滿意，我就說笑話逗他開心，或是送他小禮物什麼的。
text.simplified: 我会先了解问题是什么，然后耐心地跟他说明，想办法让他理解。我想只要态度亲切、谦虚，客人就会接受的。万一他还是不满意，我就说笑话逗他开心，或是送他小礼物什么的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiān liǎojiě wèntí shì shénme, ránhòu nàixīn de gēn tā shuōmíng, xiǎng bànfǎ ràng tā lǐjiě. Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào tàidù qīnqiè, qiānxū, kèrén jiù huì jiēshòu de. Wànyī tā háishì bù mǎnyì, wǒ jiù shuō xiàohuà dòu tā kāixīn, huòshì sòng tā xiǎo lǐwù shénme de.
text.english: I would first find out what the problem is, then patiently explain things to them and try to help them understand. I think as long as I am friendly and modest, customers will accept it. If they are still not satisfied, I will tell jokes to cheer them up, or give them a small gift or something.

text.traditional: 你的推銷觀念很正確。透過良好的溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。在職場上，你碰過什麼大問題嗎？
text.simplified: 你的推销观念很正确。透过良好的沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。在职场上，你碰过什么大问题吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ de tuīxiāo guānniàn hěn zhèngquè. Tòuguò liánghǎo de gōutōng, wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfán. Zài zhíchǎng shàng, nǐ pèng guò shénme dà wèntí ma?
text.english: Your sales philosophy is sound. Through good communication, unnecessary troubles can often be resolved. In the workplace, have you encountered any major problems?

text.traditional: 沒有。不過有一次，公司舉辦電腦遊戲比賽，經理叫我們早上七點先去布置會場，因為鬧鐘壞了，我睡到八點才醒來。等我趕到時，小組的同事早就把任務完成了。雖然大家沒怪我，但我卻不能原諒自己，從那次之後，我就非常注意時間，絕對不再遲到了。
text.simplified: 没有。不过有一次，公司举办电脑游戏比赛，经理叫我们早上七点先去布置会场，因为闹钟坏了，我睡到八点才醒来。等我赶到时，小组的同事早就把任务完成了。虽然大家没怪我，但我却不能原谅自己，从那次之后，我就非常注意时间，绝对不再迟到了。
text.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Búguò yǒu yí cì, gōngsī jǔbàn diànnǎo yóuxì bǐsài, jīnglǐ jiào wǒmen zǎoshàng qī diǎn xiān qù bùzhì huìchǎng, yīnwèi nàozhōng huài le, wǒ shuì dào bā diǎn cái xǐnglái. Děng wǒ gǎndào shí, xiǎozǔ de tóngshì zǎojiù bǎ rènwù wánchéng le. Suīrán dàjiā méi guài wǒ, dàn wǒ què bùnéng yuánliàng zìjǐ, cóng nà cì zhīhòu, wǒ jiù fēicháng zhùyì shíjiān, juéduì bú zài chídào le.
text.english: No. But once, the company held a computer gaming contest, and the manager asked us to set up at seven in the morning. My alarm broke and I slept until eight. By the time I arrived, my teammates had already finished. Though no one blamed me, I couldn't forgive myself, and since then I've been extremely punctual and never late.

text.traditional: 其實，不論在哪裡工作，準時是最基本的要求。對了，假如主管忙不過來，你願意配合加班嗎？
text.simplified: 其实，不论在哪里工作，准时是最基本的要求。对了，假如主管忙不过来，你愿意配合加班吗？
text.pinyin: Qíshí, búlùn zài nǎlǐ gōngzuò, zhǔnshí shì zuì jīběn de yāoqiú. Duìle, jiǎrú zhǔguǎn mángbúguòlái, nǐ yuànyì pèihé jiābān ma?
text.english: In fact, no matter where one works, punctuality is the most fundamental requirement. By the way, if your supervisor is too busy to keep up, would you be willing to work overtime to help out?

text.traditional: 沒問題。平日或假日，我都能配合。
text.simplified: 没问题。平日或假日，我都能配合。
text.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Píngrì huò jiàrì, wǒ dōu néng pèihé.
text.english: No problem. Weekdays or holidays, I can always help out.

text.traditional: 除了準時，請你再說說自己其他的優點。
text.simplified: 除了准时，请你再说说自己其他的优点。
text.pinyin: Chúle zhǔnshí, qǐng nǐ zài shuōshuō zìjǐ qítā de yōudiǎn.
text.english: Besides punctuality, please tell me about your other strengths.

text.traditional: 我個性開朗、說話幽默、做事細心、溝通能力強，是個容易相處的人。
text.simplified: 我个性开朗、说话幽默、做事细心、沟通能力强，是个容易相处的人。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gèxìng kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, zuòshì xìxīn, gōutōng nénglì qiáng, shì ge róngyì xiāngchǔ de rén.
text.english: I have a cheerful personality, I speak with humor, I am careful in my work, and I have strong communication skills. I am easy to get along with.

text.traditional: 聽起來你挺優秀的。對這份工作你還有什麼要了解的？
text.simplified: 听起来你挺优秀的。对这份工作你还有什么要了解的？
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái nǐ tǐng yōuxiù de. Duì zhè fèn gōngzuò nǐ háiyǒu shénme yào liǎojiě de?
text.english: You sound quite outstanding. Is there anything else you would like to know about this job?

text.traditional: 請問薪水怎麼算？有哪些福利？
text.simplified: 请问薪水怎么算？有哪些福利？
text.pinyin: Qǐngwèn xīnshuǐ zěnme suàn? Yǒu nǎxiē fúlì?
text.english: May I ask how salary is calculated? What benefits are provided?

text.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明。
text.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员来跟你详细说明。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng.
text.english: Regarding questions in this area, relevant personnel will come explain them to you in detail.

text.traditional: 好，感謝您。
text.simplified: 好，感谢您。
text.pinyin: Hǎo, gǎnxiè nín.
text.english: OK, thank you.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 這就 before a verb to say you will do something right away.

text.traditional: 請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
text.simplified: 请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
text.pinyin: Qǐng zuò yíxià, wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ.
text.english: Please have a seat; I will notify the manager right away.

text.traditional:
A：服務生，我點的是熱紅茶，不是冰咖啡。
B：對不起，我這就幫您換。
text.simplified:
A：服务生，我点的是热红茶，不是冰咖啡。
B：对不起，我这就帮您换。
text.pinyin:
A: Fúwùshēng, wǒ diǎn de shì rè hóngchá, búshì bīng kāfēi.
B: Duìbùqǐ, wǒ zhè jiù bāng nín huàn.
text.english:
A: Waiter, I ordered hot black tea, not iced coffee.
B: Sorry, I'll change it for you right away.

text.traditional:
A：經理，孔老闆快到公司了。
B：好，我這就到門口去歡迎他。
text.simplified:
A：经理，孔老板快到公司了。
B：好，我这就到门口去欢迎他。
text.pinyin:
A: Jīnglǐ, Kǒng lǎobǎn kuài dào gōngsī le.
B: Hǎo, wǒ zhè jiù dào ménkǒu qù huānyíng tā.
text.english:
A: Manager, Mr. Kong will arrive at the company soon.
B: OK, I'll go to the entrance right away to welcome him.

grammarPages.explanation: 「這」是「現在」的意思，「就」表示馬上，「這就」的後面接動詞或動詞短語，用來表示現在馬上做某事。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 這 means 現在, 就 means immediately. 這就 is followed by a verb or verb phrase to indicate that something is being done right now.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 在……方面 to name the area you are talking about, then say what is true in that area.

text.traditional: 這次我們要找的是銷售人員，你在這方面有經驗嗎？
text.simplified: 这次我们要找的是销售人员，你在这方面有经验吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xiāoshòu rényuán, nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
text.english: We are looking for salespeople this time. Do you have experience in this area?

text.traditional: 在穿著方面，白小姐很有品味，身上穿的或手上戴的也都有個人的風格。
text.simplified: 在穿着方面，白小姐很有品味，身上穿的或手上戴的也都有个人的风格。
text.pinyin: Zài chuānzhuó fāngmiàn, Bái xiǎojiě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, shēnshàng chuān de huò shǒu shàng dài de yě dōu yǒu gèrén de fēnggé.
text.english: When it comes to clothing, Miss Bai has great taste; whatever she wears, on her body or on her hands, has her own personal style.

text.traditional: 小藍從小在網球方面就表現得非常好，長大之後一定能代表國家參加比賽。
text.simplified: 小蓝从小在网球方面就表现得非常好，长大之后一定能代表国家参加比赛。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài wǎngqiú fāngmiàn jiù biǎoxiàn de fēicháng hǎo, zhǎngdà zhīhòu yídìng néng dàibiǎo guójiā cānjiā bǐsài.
text.english: Xiao Lan has been very good at tennis since childhood; when he grows up, he will surely be able to represent the country in competitions.

grammarPages.explanation: 用來說明在某個範圍或某個情況下的情形。「在」和「方面」中間是該範圍或情況，後面的句子表示產生什麼樣的情形或進一步的說明。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: It is used to describe a certain situation. The range or scope of the situation is placed between 在 and 方面, and the following sentence indicates the situation or further explanation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 往往 to say what usually happens under certain conditions, based on past experience or general facts.
grammarPages.pattern: Condition or Topic + 往往 + Usual result

text.traditional: 透過良好的溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。
text.simplified: 透过良好的沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。
text.pinyin: Tòuguò liánghǎo de gōutōng, wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfán.
text.english: Through good communication, unnecessary trouble can often be resolved.

text.traditional: 許多家長都會逼孩子念書，要不要去補習往往不是孩子能夠決定的。
text.simplified: 许多家长都会逼孩子念书，要不要去补习往往不是孩子能够决定的。
text.pinyin: Xǔduō jiāzhǎng dōu huì bī háizi niànshū, yào bú yào qù bǔxí wǎngwǎng búshì háizi nénggòu juédìng de.
text.english: Many parents force their children to study; whether to go to cram school is often not for the child to decide.

text.traditional: 一般來說，夢想與真實生活往往有一段距離，不可能每次都夢想成真。
text.simplified: 一般来说，梦想与真实生活往往有一段距离，不可能每次都梦想成真。
text.pinyin: Yìbānláishuō, mèngxiǎng yǔ zhēnshí shēnghuó wǎngwǎng yǒu yí duàn jùlí, bù kěnéng měi cì dōu mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
text.english: Generally speaking, there is often a gap between dreams and real life; dreams can't come true every time.

grammarPages.explanation:
「往往」和「常常」都表示某種情況多次出現，但「往往」的用法限制較多：
(1) 表示在一定的條件下，從過去到現在經常發生的經驗或情況，不能用在未發生的事情，而且有一定的規律。例如：過去十年，每到週末，只要天氣好，歐先生往往起床後就去慢跑。
(2)「往往」用於一般的看法或事實，不能用在個人主觀的意願，例如：家庭教育非常重要，因為孩子做人做事的態度往往是被父母影響的。
(3)「往往」不能單用「往」一個字，而且前面不能加否定詞。例如不能說：*湯先生不往往週末去打球。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
Both 往往 and 常常 often mean that a certain situation occurs multiple times, but the usage of 往往 is more restrictive:
(1) 往往 and 常常 mean that under certain conditions, the experience or situation has frequently occurred from the past to the present, and cannot be used for things that have not happened. 往往 and 常常 always follow a certain pattern. For example, 過去十年，每到週末，只要天氣好，歐先生往往起床後就去慢跑。
(2) 往往 is used for general opinions or facts, and cannot be used for personal subjective wishes. For example, 家庭教育非常重要，因為孩子做人做事的態度往往是被父母影響的。
(3) 往往 cannot be used with one character 往 alone, and no negative word can be added before it. For example, it is not correct to say: *湯先生不往往週末去打球。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Start a sentence with 有關 to name the topic ('about …'), then explain it or give advice.
grammarPages.pattern: 有關 + Topic, + Explanation or Advice

text.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明。
text.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员来跟你详细说明。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng.
text.english: Regarding questions in this area, the staff in charge will come and explain them to you in detail.

text.traditional: 有關那個明星吸毒的新聞，還要經過詳細地調查，才能確定是真是假。
text.simplified: 有关那个明星吸毒的新闻，还要经过详细地调查，才能确定是真是假。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān nàge míngxīng xīdú de xīnwén, hái yào jīngguò xiángxì de diàochá, cái néng quèdìng shì zhēn shì jiǎ.
text.english: Regarding the news that the celebrity took drugs, a detailed investigation is still needed before we can be sure whether it is true or false.

text.traditional: 有關法律方面的問題，你最好請教專業律師，不要隨便相信網路上的說法。
text.simplified: 有关法律方面的问题，你最好请教专业律师，不要随便相信网路上的说法。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān fǎlǜ fāngmiàn de wèntí, nǐ zuìhǎo qǐngjiào zhuānyè lǜshī, búyào suíbiàn xiāngxìn wǎnglù shàng de shuōfǎ.
text.english: For legal questions, you had better consult a professional lawyer rather than casually believing claims online.

grammarPages.explanation: 「有關」常放在句首，連接事物或情況，後面的句子表示進一步地說明或建議。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 有關 is often placed at the beginning of a sentence to connect things or situations, and the following sentence indicates further explanation or suggestion.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 我的面試經驗

text.traditional: 一般來說，現代人找工作得經過面試。面試時表現得好，被錄取的機會就比較大。今天，我就來跟各位說說我最近面試的經驗和感想。
text.simplified: 一般来说，现代人找工作得经过面试。面试时表现得好，被录取的机会就比较大。今天，我就来跟各位说说我最近面试的经验和感想。
text.pinyin: Yìbānláishuō, xiàndài rén zhǎo gōngzuò děi jīngguò miànshì. Miànshì shí biǎoxiàn de hǎo, bèi lùqǔ de jīhuì jiù bǐjiào dà. Jīntiān, wǒ jiù lái gēn gèwèi shuōshuo wǒ zuìjìn miànshì de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng.
text.english: Generally speaking, modern people must go through interviews to find jobs. Performing well in an interview brings greater chances of being hired. Today, let me share my recent interview experience and thoughts with everyone.

text.traditional: 上個月，我在網站上，看到某家企業有銷售人員的需求，就立刻把個人資料寄過去。資料中除了說明我過去的工作經驗，也包含我對工作的看法和態度。兩個星期之後，我收到了面試通知。儘管我不是第一次參加面試，但還是擔心表現不佳，所以面試當天很早就醒來，出門前還一再確認穿著是不是整齊、資料是不是都放進了背包。我想，這樣又緊張又興奮的心情，往往是面試時經常有的表現。
text.simplified: 上个月，我在网站上，看到某家企业有销售人员的需求，就立刻把个人资料寄过去。资料中除了说明我过去的工作经验，也包含我对工作的看法和态度。两个星期之后，我收到了面试通知。尽管我不是第一次参加面试，但还是担心表现不佳，所以面试当天很早就醒来，出门前还一再确认穿着是不是整齐、资料是不是都放进了背包。我想，这样又紧张又兴奋的心情，往往是面试时经常有的表现。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ zài wǎngzhàn shàng, kàndào mǒu jiā qìyè yǒu xiāoshòu rényuán de xūqiú, jiù lìkè bǎ gèrén zīliào jì guòqù. Zīliào zhōng chúle shuōmíng wǒ guòqù de gōngzuò jīngyàn, yě bāohán wǒ duì gōngzuò de kànfǎ hé tàidù. Liǎng ge xīngqí zhīhòu, wǒ shōudào le miànshì tōngzhī. Jǐnguǎn wǒ búshì dì yī cì cānjiā miànshì, dàn háishì dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā, suǒyǐ miànshì dāngtiān hěn zǎo jiù xǐnglái, chū mén qián hái yízài quèrèn chuānzhuó shì bú shì zhěngqí, zīliào shì bú shì dōu fàng jìn le bēibāo. Wǒ xiǎng, zhèyàng yòu jǐnzhāng yòu xīngfèn de xīnqíng, wǎngwǎng shì miànshì shí jīngcháng yǒu de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: Last month, I saw on a website that an enterprise needed sales personnel and sent my personal information immediately. Beyond outlining my past work experience, the materials covered my views and attitudes toward work. Two weeks later, I received an interview notification. Even though it wasn't my first interview, I still worried about performing poorly, so I woke up very early on the day, and before leaving home I checked again and again that my clothes were neat and that all my papers were in my backpack. I think this kind of nervous yet excited feeling is often how people react at interviews.

text.traditional: 一開始，經理請我說明對銷售工作的想法。我回答他，銷售人員是最常接觸顧客的，所以對客人要有禮貌，態度也要主動，絕對不能像木頭一樣沒反應；萬一他們亂發脾氣，就該忍耐、冷靜。畢竟，只顧自己的感覺，把跟顧客的關係搞壞，甚至變成了敵人，又有什麼好處呢？
text.simplified: 一开始，经理请我说明对销售工作的想法。我回答他，销售人员是最常接触顾客的，所以对客人要有礼貌，态度也要主动，绝对不能像木头一样没反应；万一他们乱发脾气，就该忍耐、冷静。毕竟，只顾自己的感觉，把跟顾客的关系搞坏，甚至变成了敌人，又有什么好处呢？
text.pinyin: Yìkāishǐ, jīnglǐ qǐng wǒ shuōmíng duì xiāoshòu gōngzuò de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ huídá tā, xiāoshòu rényuán shì zuì cháng jiēchù gùkè de, suǒyǐ duì kèrén yào yǒu lǐmào, tàidù yě yào zhǔdòng, juéduì bùnéng xiàng mùtou yíyàng méi fǎnyìng; wànyī tāmen luàn fāpíqì, jiù gāi rěnnài, lěngjìng. Bìjìng, zhǐ gù zìjǐ de gǎnjué, bǎ gēn gùkè de guānxì gǎo huài, shènzhì biànchéng le dírén, yòu yǒu shénme hǎochù ne?
text.english: To begin, the manager asked for my thoughts on sales work. I replied that sales staff have the closest contact with customers, so one must be polite, take the initiative, and never act unresponsive like a piece of wood. If customers lose their temper, one should be patient and calm. After all, considering only one's own feelings and ruining relations with customers, or even making enemies of them, brings no benefit.

text.traditional: 後來，經理又問我對團體合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小組的方式來推銷產品，所以能理解合作是必要的。況且，主管要領導整個部門，為全公司創造好成績，要是小組人員不配合，恐怕就不能順利實行銷售計畫，也會出現混亂的情況。因此，為了公司，我認為不論主管有什麼要求，只要是合理的，員工都應該配合。
text.simplified: 后来，经理又问我对团体合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小组的方式来推销产品，所以能理解合作是必要的。况且，主管要领导整个部门，为全公司创造好成绩，要是小组人员不配合，恐怕就不能顺利实行销售计划，也会出现混乱的情况。因此，为了公司，我认为不论主管有什么要求，只要是合理的，员工都应该配合。
text.pinyin: Hòulái, jīnglǐ yòu wèn wǒ duì tuántǐ hézuò de kànfǎ. Wǒ zhīqián de gōngzuò, jiùshì yǐ xiǎozǔ de fāngshì lái tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn, suǒyǐ néng lǐjiě hézuò shì bìyào de. Kuàngqiě, zhǔguǎn yào lǐngdǎo zhěngge bùmén, wèi quán gōngsī chuàngzào hǎo chéngjī, yàoshì xiǎozǔ rényuán bú pèihé, kǒngpà jiù bùnéng shùnlì shíxíng xiāoshòu jìhuà, yě huì chūxiàn hùnluàn de qíngkuàng. Yīncǐ, wèile gōngsī, wǒ rènwéi búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, zhǐyào shì hélǐ de, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
text.english: Later, the manager asked about my views on teamwork. In my previous job we sold products in small teams, so I understand that teamwork is necessary. Moreover, a supervisor has to lead the whole department and get good results for the whole company; if the team members don't cooperate, I'm afraid the sales plan can't be carried out smoothly, and things will get chaotic. So, for the good of the company, I believe that no matter what the supervisor asks, as long as it is reasonable, employees should go along with it.

text.traditional: 最後，經理問我要是被錄取了，能為公司付出什麼。我說，在推銷產品方面，我的經驗很豐富，商品銷售可說是我一輩子的事業，所以一定會盡最大的力量認真工作、完成任務。
text.simplified: 最后，经理问我要是被录取了，能为公司付出什么。我说，在推销产品方面，我的经验很丰富，商品销售可说是我一辈子的事业，所以一定会尽最大的力量认真工作、完成任务。
text.pinyin: Zuìhòu, jīnglǐ wèn wǒ yàoshì bèi lùqǔ le, néng wèi gōngsī fùchū shénme. Wǒ shuō, zài tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn fāngmiàn, wǒ de jīngyàn hěn fēngfù, shāngpǐn xiāoshòu kě shuō shì wǒ yíbèizi de shìyè, suǒyǐ yídìng huì jìn zuì dà de lìliàng rènzhēn gōngzuò, wánchéng rènwù.
text.english: Finally, the manager asked what I could contribute to the company if hired. I stated that my experience in sales is extensive, that sales can be said to be my lifelong career, and that I would do my very best to work hard and complete my tasks.

text.traditional: 上星期我收到了通過面試的通知，下個月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我終於美夢成真了。很多人說，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一點兒運氣。其實，個性、能力，加上不斷地努力才是最重要的。
text.simplified: 上星期我收到了通过面试的通知，下个月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我终于美梦成真了。很多人说，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一点儿运气。其实，个性、能力，加上不断地努力才是最重要的。
text.pinyin: Shàng xīngqí wǒ shōudào le tōngguò miànshì de tōngzhī, xià ge yuè jiùyào shàngbān le. Pànwàng le hǎojiǔ, wǒ zhōngyú měimèng chéngzhēn le. Hěn duō rén shuō, xiǎng zhǎodào lǐxiǎng de gōngzuò, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào yìdiǎnr yùnqì. Qíshí, gèxìng, nénglì, jiāshàng búduàn de nǔlì cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
text.english: Last week I received notification of passing the interview, and I start next month. After longing for so long, my dream has finally come true. Many say finding an ideal job takes a bit of luck, but personality, ability, and persistent effort are truly what matter most.

text.traditional: 以上就是我找工作的經驗和感想，如果有任何問題，歡迎跟我聯絡，謝謝！
text.simplified: 以上就是我找工作的经验和感想，如果有任何问题，欢迎跟我联络，谢谢！
text.pinyin: Yǐshàng jiùshì wǒ zhǎo gōngzuò de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng, rúguǒ yǒu rènhé wèntí, huānyíng gēn wǒ liánluò, xièxie!
text.english: The above is my experience and reflection on job seeking. If you have questions, please feel free to contact me. Thank you!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 儘管 to state a fact, then show with 但是, 可是, 還是 or 卻 that the result goes against it.
grammarPages.pattern: 儘管 + Fact, + (但是 / 可是 / 還是 / 卻) + Contrary Result

text.traditional: 儘管我不是第一次參加面試，但還是擔心表現不佳……
text.simplified: 尽管我不是第一次参加面试，但还是担心表现不佳……
text.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǒ búshì dì yī cì cānjiā miànshì, dàn háishì dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā…
text.english: Even though this isn't my first interview, I'm still worried that I won't do well…

text.traditional: 儘管他平時測驗的成績都不理想，卻不影響他對中文的興趣。
text.simplified: 尽管他平时测验的成绩都不理想，却不影响他对中文的兴趣。
text.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā píngshí cèyàn de chéngjī dōu bù lǐxiǎng, què bù yǐngxiǎng tā duì Zhōngwén de xìngqù.
text.english: Although his test scores are usually poor, they do not affect his interest in Chinese.

text.traditional: 儘管已經下課了，張老師還是留在教室裡改作業，直到晚餐時間才離開。
text.simplified: 尽管已经下课了，张老师还是留在教室里改作业，直到晚餐时间才离开。
text.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng xiàkè le, Zhāng lǎoshī háishì liú zài jiàoshì lǐ gǎi zuòyè, zhídào wǎncān shíjiān cái líkāi.
text.english: Although class was already over, Teacher Zhang still stayed in the classroom grading homework and didn't leave until dinnertime.

grammarPages.explanation: 「儘管」是連詞，用在第一個句子的句首，主要用來描述事實或某件事的結論，與「雖然」的意思相近；後面的分句常用「可是、但是、還是、卻」，表示與前句的結果相反。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 儘管 is a conjunction, similar to 雖然, and is used in the first half of the sentence. 儘管 is mainly used to describe the facts, or the conclusion of one thing. The second half of the sentence is often used with 但是, 可是, 卻 or 還是, indicating that the result of the first half is the opposite of what was hoped for or expected.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 不論……都…… to say that whatever the situation, the result stays the same.
grammarPages.pattern: 不論 + Situation, + Subject + 都 + Result

text.traditional: 我認為不論主管有什麼要求，只要是合理的，員工都應該配合。
text.simplified: 我认为不论主管有什么要求，只要是合理的，员工都应该配合。
text.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, zhǐyào shì hélǐ de, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
text.english: I think that no matter what demands the supervisor makes, as long as they are reasonable, employees should cooperate.

text.traditional: 包老闆很堅持自己的想法，不論你說什麼，他都不會改變。
text.simplified: 包老板很坚持自己的想法，不论你说什么，他都不会改变。
text.pinyin: Bāo lǎobǎn hěn jiānchí zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, búlùn nǐ shuō shénme, tā dōu bú huì gǎibiàn.
text.english: Boss Bao is very stubborn about his own ideas; no matter what you say, he won't change his mind.

text.traditional: 不論你有升學或工作方面的問題，都可以請教紀伯伯，他一定能給你寶貴的意見。
text.simplified: 不论你有升学或工作方面的问题，都可以请教纪伯伯，他一定能给你宝贵的意见。
text.pinyin: Búlùn nǐ yǒu shēngxué huò gōngzuò fāngmiàn de wèntí, dōu kěyǐ qǐngjiào Jì bóbo, tā yídìng néng gěi nǐ bǎoguì de yìjiàn.
text.english: No matter whether you have questions about further study or work, you can consult Uncle Ji, who will surely give you valuable advice.

text.traditional: 我為了這次的比賽準備了很久，不論教練去不去，我都要參加。
text.simplified: 我为了这次的比赛准备了很久，不论教练去不去，我都要参加。
text.pinyin: Wǒ wèile zhè cì de bǐsài zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ, búlùn jiàoliàn qù bú qù, wǒ dōu yào cānjiā.
text.english: I have been preparing for this competition for a long time; whether or not the coach goes, I will take part.

grammarPages.explanation: 用來表示雖然情況不同，但是最後的結果不因情況而受影響。「不論」的後面可搭配疑問詞、反義複合詞（例如：高低、大小、上下、左右、胖瘦、生死、長短、快慢等等）或 A not A 句，表示各種情況；「都」後面則是一定會出現的結果或事實。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不論……都…… is used to indicate that although the situation is different, the final result is not affected by the situation. 不論 is followed by question words, antisense compound words (such as 大小, 高矮, 胖瘦, 遠近, etc.) or, "A not A sentences", indicating various situations. 都 is followed by the result or fact that will definitely occur.
